2119089109537063022.en_summary: People are underestimating how much of this AI selloff has become a positioning event rather than any real changes to the AI buildout. Once funds start cutting exposure then leverage comes down and options hedging adds even more selling pressure. $AMD saying demand still exceeds supply and expecting revenue growth above 80% in 2027 while $PLTR just grew revenue 96% without even being an infrastructure company yet both are trading as though they're exposed to same risks.
2119089109537063022.zh_summary: 人們低估了這次 AI 拋售有多少已成為倉位事件而非 AI 建設的任何實質變化。一旦基金開始削減敞口，槓桿就會下降，期權對沖會增加更多拋售壓力。$AMD 表示需求仍超過供應，並預期 2027 年營收增長超過 80%，而 $PLTR 剛實現營收增長 96%，甚至還不是基礎設施公司，但兩者交易時好像面臨相同風險。

2119087830907666759.en_summary: $MSFT an old 2023 contract to support AI-powered Bing ended, and Microsoft declined to renew. Older generation GPUs did not fit this specific customer's use case, that doesn't mean they dunked on Oracle. If this happened to new B300 contracts that would be worrisome, but the recent media headlines are extremely misleading.
2119087830907666759.zh_summary: $MSFT 一份 2023 年支持 AI 驅動 Bing 的舊合同結束，微軟拒絕續約。舊一代 GPU 不適合這個特定客戶的用例，這並不意味著他們擊敗了 Oracle。如果這發生在新的 B300 合同上會令人擔憂，但最近的媒體頭條極其誤導。

2119085455375503816.en_summary: Now fundamentally positive on $IREN post Mirantis acquisition and after their recent earnings. Their operating outlook and ability to finance has looked more compelling. Caution regarding their existing $6B ATM, which now has $2.37B left. Also caution on CEO executive compensation which would be more beneficial if done through appreciating share prices rather than dilution. NBA Warriors deals have very bad optics while unprofitable but treat as noise relative to the scale of the ATM overhang and executive comp. These can still be addressed.
2119085455375503816.zh_summary: 在 Mirantis 收購和最近業績後，現在從基本面上對 $IREN 持正面態度。其經營前景和融資能力看起來更具吸引力。對現有 60 億美元 ATM（現剩 23.7 億美元）持謹慎態度。對 CEO 高管薪酬也持謹慎，認為通過股價升值而非稀釋會更有益。NBA 勇士隊交易在未盈利時光學效果很差，但相對於 ATM 懸置和高管薪酬規模，應視為噪音。這些仍可解決。
